album: Man on the Moon: The End of Day

meta.title: Soundtrack 2 My Life
meta.album: Man on the Moon: The End of Day

body: Though his family treated him all kindly, they weren’t aware of his sad feelings. Not because they weren’t empathic, but rather because he wouldn’t show a sign. He wouldn’t open up, he kept to himself. Cudi explained:
This album was my way of finally letting out a lot of feelings that I’ve yet to even mention to my mother.
She worries about me anyway, but I think the album is gonna open her eyes about a lot of stuff.
